text:
Laura: heads up — noticed multiple private/VPC rollouts getting stuck in the canary phase for >10m. customers on air-gapped packs show repeated control-plane retries and no acks
Manny: yep, saw 3 of those this morning. UI still shows 10% but backend shows 0/expected acks from the node pool (they're on a stretched network)
Laura: here's the snippet from the control-plane log (sanitized):
```
2026-09-12T09:12:03Z controlplane push start tenant=acme-corp rollout=rt-42 seq=193
2026-09-12T09:12:13Z push retry tenant=acme-corp seq=193 err=timeout waiting for agent ack
2026-09-12T09:22:03Z push fail tenant=acme-corp seq=193 attempts=6
```
Manny: classic airgap fetch-delay behavior. Our current guard just waits and then falls back to previous model, but doesn't surface 'stalled' to the console clearly
Jia: proposal: introduce a heartbeat/ack guard and a "stalled" state. If %acked < X after Y minutes, mark canary as STALLED (not FAILED) and require manual resume or an explicit force with audit note
Samir: also add a routing guard in the control plane: prevent auto-promotion beyond the last confirmed slice if there's any missing ack for >N unique nodes. We can't risk flipping 10% -> 100% when nodes are half offline
Laura: UX ideas — console should show per-tenant pending-diff size, last_ack_ts, and a best-effort ETA (based on past ack rates). Add an inline "resume when ready" button that does a handshake instead of a blind promote
Manny: for air-gapped customers we should surface a signed bundle export option: control plane creates a signed rollout bundle + apply script they can scp into their isolated cluster. That way ops can apply locally and ack back when ready
Jia: telemetry we need: gauge private.rollout.pending_acks{tenant}, counter controlplane.push.retries, histogram controlplane.push.latency, and a derived alert when p95 latency > 30s AND pending_acks > 0
Samir: agree. I'll add the middleware to track ack counts and push a small state-machine change: CANARY -> STALLED -> AWAITING_APPROVAL -> RESUME/ROLLBACK. Also enforce that automated progression is blocked if stalled_time > threshold
Laura: sample API for signed bundle export (proto):
```
POST /v1/private/tenants/acme-corp/rollouts/rt-42/export-bundle
{
  "canary_slice": 10,
  "include_configs": true,
  "signature_ttl": "72h"
}
```
Manny: server will return tarball url + signature. We should also include an example resume handshake:
```
POST /v1/private/tenants/acme-corp/rollouts/rt-42/resume
{
  "resume_token": "signed-bundle-ack-abc123",
  "operator_note": "applied locally at 2026-09-12T11:30Z"
}
```
deploy-bot: rollout rt-42 canary 10% applied -> 2/20 nodes acked (2 confirmed) :white_check_mark:
Jia: tiny UX detail — show the last push seq and a link to the exact push log (read-only) and let SRE add a temporary override window with elevated audit (7d max)
Samir: I'll draft the change PR for the state-machine + metric names. Will also gate auto-promote behind a config flag defaulted off for private deployments
Laura: thanks — I'll mock console wireframes for the stalled state and the export/resume flow and share in #design later. Also add an educational tooltip: "Why stalled?" that points to troubleshooting steps
Manny: can someone add a short playbook for on-call? steps: 1) check pending_acks metric 2) check agent connectivity 3) offer export bundle 4) coordinate with customer to resume
Jia: I'll add the alerts and playbook snippets to the runbook. Assigning follow-ups: Samir (state-machine + metrics), Manny (bundle export + resume API), Laura (console wireframes + tooltip), Jia (alerts + runbook)
Laura: perfect. if we can get the metrics in next deploy we can start testing with a synthetic flaky-node lab tomorrow
Samir: will ping once PR is up. tl;dr — don't auto-promote past a partial canary for private clusters; add STALLED state + signed-bundle resume for air-gapped
Manny: noted. :thumbsup:
